context: Request: build an MFN clause bank; pull all deals with a 'most favored nation' provision. Rubric: 17 qualifying matters (1001-00002, 1001-00007, 1003-00003, 1004-00001, 1005-00001, 1008-00003, 1009-00001, 1013-00002, 1013-00003, 1018-00006, 1019-00002, 1021-00001, 1022-00008, 1023-00001, 1027-00002, 1041-00003, 1042-00002) plus a precision criterion. Diligence-only, draft, term-sheet and sibling-fund matters (e.g. 1003-00002, 1037-00004, 1001-00004, 1002-00002) are outside the set.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob with a capped folder listing and a file count.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: find | grep over paths for the request term and its spellings (23 paths in nine matters), in parallel with a capped listing of transaction-document folders.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: A store-wide extraction script times out; a rerun split into eight parallel parts also times out; the agent concatenates the part outputs as they stand (508 hit files, 91 matters) and filters them to the exact term. The review says completion of the parts was never confirmed.

Heredoc and index errors, then file listings of the 91 scan-hit matters (first 260 lines), a filtered listing of agreement-type files for the exact-term matters, and per-matter greps of the saved hits for 27 hand-picked matters.
Attempt 2: writes a per-matter file inventory of the 91 matters to a file; the visible tail does not match its header.
Attempt 3: re-derives the 91 matters and prints file counts per matter.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads openings (20-60 lines) of 16 agreements and memos across about 15 candidates. The review says the reads stop at cover pages.

stages.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
stages.note: Filters the saved scan hits by folder name, picks one key file per matter, runs a snippet script over selected agreements and memos (about 52K chars) and over six more, and greps the saved hits for single matters. The review calls one candidate's clause a parity term, not clearly the request term.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads two diligence memos of two matters raised by the review; a stage_start for writing is refused while this stage is open.

Writes a three-tier inventory: operative provisions, underlying contracts confirmed by diligence, and draft-only language, plus exclusions. The review flags that the diligence-only and draft tiers inflate the list.
Re-reads the response, expands abbreviated paths with about 25 edits (one fails on a duplicate string), fixes a missing path, and deletes one diligence row as a duplicate.
Attempt 2: reads the diligence memo and purchase agreement of the deleted row's matter; keeps it out.
Attempt 3: a snippet script finds no request-term hits in those two documents.
Attempt 4: confirms the two documents extract to non-empty text with no hits.
Attempt 5: re-reads the response and re-checks cited paths.
Calls finish.

runs.failure_point: Its store-wide scan ran as parallel parts cut off by the time limit, and the merged partial output became the candidate set, so some matters never surfaced; the answer also counts diligence-only and draft matters.

first_error.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
first_error.why: Both store-wide scans timed out and the merged output of the eight cut-off parts was taken as the whole store; two needed matters never appear in any result, and the later listings and reads all start from that partial list.
first_error.critic_note: (specific flag) The scan review at [31] said completion of the parallel parts was never confirmed and asked to compare the matters scanned with the store; the agent moved on to listing without rerunning.

other_errors.why: A needed matter with request-term file names surfaced in the file-name search at [13] (and in the agent's own summary at [14]), but the candidate set was rebuilt from the partial scan output only, so the matter was never listed or read.
other_errors.critic_note: (generic flag) The stock unopened-matters lists in the reviews at [81] and [99] named it among dozens of matters.

other_errors.why: A needed matter's executed co-investment agreement with a no-less-favourable investment clause was seen in the snippets at [95]; the answer lists it under matters not counted.
other_errors.critic_note: The in-matter search review at [99] called that clause a parity term, not clearly the request term, and the answer excluded it.

other_errors.why: The answer presents diligence-only underlying-contract matters and draft-only matters as part of the inventory (evidence seen at [62]-[99] and [102]-[104]), asserting several matters outside the qualifying set.
other_errors.critic_note: (specific flag) The write review at [114] said the diligence-only and draft-only tiers inflate the list and asked to move them to an excluded list; the check stages kept the tiers.

runs.failure_point: After seeing a matter's operative clause in its own snippet output, it left that matter off its hand-picked core list, and the answer counts term-sheet and diligence-only matters.

first_error.why: The agent saw a needed matter's executed credit agreement clause in its own snippet output at [58] but left it out of the hand-picked core list at [82]; the answer lists it among excluded scan hits.
first_error.critic_note: (specific flag) The reviews at [87] and [93] said the 24-matter core list could silently drop a qualifying matter and asked for each excluded matter's snippets to be checked; the agent only printed the difference set.

other_errors.why: The answer asserts a binding settlement term sheet and diligence-only underlying-contract matters as matters with the provision (evidence seen at [56]-[71]), several outside the qualifying set.
other_errors.critic_note: (specific flag) The write review at [99] said term-sheet and diligence-only matters may inflate the count; the check stage relabelled the tiers instead of removing them.

divergence: All fail, each on the precision criterion plus missing matters, at different stages. Common: every run wrote a tiered answer that counts diligence-only underlying contracts, drafts or a term sheet beside operative provisions (over-inclusion at the write stage), and in every run the write review named that risk specifically and the check stages kept the tiers. The omissions differ: T0's store-wide scan ran as eight cut-off parallel parts that were merged without a completion check, so two matters never surfaced (first error at the scan; the review flagged it) and a third, surfaced only by file name, was dropped; T0 also excluded one matter after the review called its clause a parity term. T1 completed its range scan but left a surfaced matter out of every reading batch and misattributed a credit agreement after parallel reads. T2 reached all 17 matters and saw the snippets of all of them, but its hand-picked core list dropped one, which the reviews flagged generically by mechanism.
